Title: New user registers with valid details
Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/register; 2. Fill all required fields with valid data; 3. Click Register
Expected Result: User is redirected to login page; Registration success message displayed

Title: Login with valid existing credentials
Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/login; 2. Enter valid email and password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User lands on account/home page; Nav shows account menu

Title: Login with invalid credentials – negative
Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/login; 2. Enter wrong email/password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message displayed; User stays on login page

Title: Search for a product by keyword
Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage; 2. Enter 'hammer' in search box; 3. Click Search
Expected Result: Product results are displayed; At least 1 result visible

Title: Add product to cart when logged in
Steps: 1. Search for 'hammer'; 2. Click first product; 3. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: Cart counter increments; Product visible in cart

Title: End-to-end checkout with Cash on Delivery
Preconditions: User logged in with item in cart
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout; 2. Select billing address; 3. Select Cash on Delivery; 4. Click Confirm (first time); 5. Click Confirm (second time)
Expected Result: Invoice number generated; Order confirmation displayed

Title: Update product quantity in cart
Preconditions: User logged in with item in cart
Steps: 1. Navigate to cart; 2. Change quantity to 2; 3. Press Enter or click update
Expected Result: Cart total updates; Quantity reflects new value

Title: Register new user via API
Expected Result: 201 Created; Response body contains email and first_name

Title: Login via API returns access token
Expected Result: 200 OK; access_token present in response body

Title: Login with invalid credentials via API – negative
Get paginated product list
Expected Result: 200 OK; data array non-empty; pagination metadata present

Title: Get product by valid ID
Steps: GET /products/{id} with first product id from list
Expected Result: 200 OK; id name price fields present

Title: Full lifecycle: create cart → add product → generate invoice
Preconditions: User logged in with bearer token
Steps: 1. POST /carts; 2. GET /products; 3. POST /carts/{id}/products; 4. POST /invoices with billing + cart_id
Expected Result: 201 on each step; invoice.id present; status field present
